description.zh: 把 0.4.3 的敌人/干员/驻防/装置/领袖/乐队/效果并入 0.3.3；stages/waves 只并新增，factions 只并 types 池。技能/规则代码需另配 —— 数据本身不代表完整可玩。
description.en: Merges 0.4.3 enemies/operators/garrisons/tokens/bosses/bands/effects into 0.3.3; stages/waves only add new keys; factions only unions type pools. Skill/rule code is separate — data alone is not full playability.
